_doc: VN female body type cluster centroids in (height_cm, S/H, W/H, S/T, T/L, A/T) space. Derived from Trieu et al. 2024 cluster descriptions and Vietnam STEPS Survey 2009/2015 anthropometry. Within-cluster covariance is a diagonal approximation tuned to give ~80% accuracy on simulated users sampled from the cluster descriptions.
_source_paper: Trieu et al. 2024, 'Analysis of Vietnamese Women's Body Shape from Anthropometric Data', N=480 women age 18-50
_population_priors: Vietnam STEPS Survey 2009/2015 — VN women mean height 154.5 cm, mean BMI 21-22
_feature_std_doc: Per-feature std for Mahalanobis distance (diagonal covariance). Estimated from VN STEPS within-population variance scaled to cluster width.
